answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 45945 Country: India Title: Nikah Question: Is nikah eligible when a woman in menstruation cycle? If yes/no, why and how? Please reply it soon. Answer ID: 45945 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 875/678/H=1434) Haiz (menstruation cycle) is not a hindrance for nikah to be valid. Nikah is valid in haiz as well. However, it is haram to have intercourse while the wife is experiencing menstruation cycle. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
